content:
Retrieves details for the specified profile. The type of profile returned depends on the
sensor_type  path parameter, which can be set to either agent  or scanners .
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "agent"
"scanners"
The type of sensor. Use agent  for agent profiles or scanners  for
scanner profiles.
string <uuid>
The unique identifier (UUID) of the profile.
